q: The power of a lens is inversely proportional to the ____ length of the lens.
e: Work is F · s. Power is work per second, in watts. The power of a lens is inversely proportional to the focal length of the lens.

q: The power of a lens is denoted by the letter ____.
e: Work is F · s. Power is work per second, in watts. The power of a lens is denoted by the letter P.

q: The lens having greater power can make the rays parallel to the principal axis more convergent (or) ____.
e: Work is F · s. Power is work per second, in watts. The lens having greater power can make the rays parallel to the principal axis more convergent (or) divergent.

q: The shorter the focal length the ____ is the power of the lens.
e: Work is F · s. Power is work per second, in watts. The shorter the focal length the greater is the power of the lens.

q: Since the focal length of a convex lens is positive in sign it has a ____ power.
e: Work is F · s. Power is work per second, in watts. Since the focal length of a convex lens is positive in sign it has a positive power.

q: The focal length of a concave lens is negative so that it has a ____ power.
e: Work is F · s. Power is work per second, in watts. The focal length of a concave lens is negative so that it has a negative power.

q: The sign of the powers of the lenses used here are the same as those used by the ____ makers.
e: Work is F · s. Power is work per second, in watts. The sign of the powers of the lenses used here are the same as those used by the lens makers.

q: If a lens has a focal length of 1 metre, it has one unit power (or) one ____.
e: Work is F · s. Power is work per second, in watts. If a lens has a focal length of 1 metre, it has one unit power (or) one dioptre.

q: One unit of power of a lens is denoted by ____.
e: Work is F · s. Power is work per second, in watts. One unit of power of a lens is denoted by D.

q: If the focal length $f$ is measured in metre, the power is $P = $ ____.
e: Work is F · s. Power is work per second, in watts. If the focal length f is measured in metre, the power is P = (1)/(f (m)).

q: If the focal length $f$ is measured in centimetre, the power is $P = $ ____.
e: Work is F · s. Power is work per second, in watts. If the focal length f is measured in centimetre, the power is P = (100)/(f (cm)).

q: If the power of a lens is $+2 \text{ D}$, it is a ____ lens.
e: Work is F · s. Power is work per second, in watts. If the power of a lens is +2 D, it is a convex lens.

q: If the power of a lens is $+2 \text{ D}$, its focal length is ____ m.
e: Work is F · s. Power is work per second, in watts. If the power of a lens is +2 D, its focal length is 0.5 m.

q: If the power of a lens is $-4 \text{ D}$, it is a ____ lens.
e: Work is F · s. Power is work per second, in watts. If the power of a lens is -4 D, it is a concave lens.

q: If the power of a lens is $-4 \text{ D}$, its focal length is ____ cm.
e: Work is F · s. Power is work per second, in watts. If the power of a lens is -4 D, its focal length is 25 cm.
